segments.summary: Reviewed external autonomous-QA boundaries, progress symbols, tracker selection, QA interfaces, and feedback mutation; found accessibility, projection, determinism, interface, and race gaps while preserving explicit non-executable authority boundaries.
Reviewed phase gates, pause-file and GUI signaling, commit examples, loop control, DRY invocation, and preflight recovery; identified atomicity, TOCTOU, delivery, and unbounded-retry gaps.

Reviewed task/phase inspection loops, QA benefit and implementation evidence, progress visibility, and configuration examples; found feedback idempotency, phase-oracle, accessibility, and schema gaps.

Reviewed media capability gating, sharded graph consumption, legacy Persona labels, Persona resolution config, runtime records, and UI events; found TOCTOU, snapshot, precedence, lifecycle, and secure-delivery gaps.

Reviewed auto Persona signals, registry import, compatibility acceptance, ready-set scheduling, worktree conflicts, and wake cascades; found trust, contradiction, fairness, recovery, and cascade-bound gaps.

Reviewed temporal waits, projection fields, remediation, classifiers, graph lock, and event-driven GUI alignment; found durable-clock, schema, transition, precedence, lock-atomicity, and critical stream-resync gaps.

Reviewed scheduler snapshots, blocked lineage, immediate wakes, capacity deferral, remediation visibility, and same-cycle scheduling; found lifecycle, recovery, fairness, race, and bounded-fixpoint gaps.

Reviewed runtime counters, recovered SubagentPolicy config, registry identity, continuity, bounded waves, and ambient discovery; found counter, validation, normalization, limit/write-admission, and discovery trust gaps while confirming strong continuity lifecycle boundaries.
